title: Experimental units and independence
outcome: Explain experimental units and independence using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Photos are not always independent plants. A dataset has twelve photos: three views of each of four plants. The intended use is identifying new plants.
given: Plant IDs P1–P4 each have three views. All views of a plant must stay in one split.

steps.label: Identify the unit
steps.detail: Four plants, not twelve independent plants, generated the observations.

steps.label: Group before splitting
steps.detail: Assign whole plant IDs to training or evaluation.

steps.label: Trace a valid split
steps.detail: Train on P1,P2 and evaluate on P3,P4: six photos per split.

explanation: Repeated views from one object share information. Counting them as independent units or scattering them across splits can exaggerate evidence for new-object performance.

counterfactual.change: Put one P1 view into evaluation while other P1 views train.
counterfactual.prediction: Flag object-level leakage for this new-plant target.
counterfactual.reason: Evaluation now includes a plant already represented during training.

student_task: Count independent plants and photo views. Construct the stated group-correct split, then explain why placing a P1 view in evaluation creates leakage for the new-plant goal.
teacher_answer: Four plants, not twelve independent plants, generated the observations. Assign whole plant IDs to training or evaluation. Train on P1,P2 and evaluate on P3,P4: six photos per split. Changed case: Flag object-level leakage for this new-plant target. Evaluation now includes a plant already represented during training.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: Four plants offer little population coverage; even a group-correct split may be too small for broad conclusions.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
